detail.title: Riser 50 Wooden Book Stand with 360° Rotating Base - Brown
detail.overview: The Ant Riser 50 is a wooden book holder stand with a 360-degree rotating base, built for reading books, cookbooks, tablets or laptops at a comfortable angle without holding them in hand. Height and multi-angle adjustment let you dial in the exact position for reading in bed, at a desk or in the kitchen while cooking, and the sturdy wooden build gives it a warm, natural look that suits most home décor. Its stable base keeps the stand firmly in place while in use, making it a versatile reading and desk accessory for books, tablets and light laptop use alike.
